name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies is a seasoned catering manager with over 20 years of experience in the hospitality industry, the last 12 of which have been dedicated to the high-octane world of motorsport. A lifelong racing enthusiast, Alistair transitioned from managing upscale restaurants to providing top-notch culinary experiences for teams and VIP guests at racing events. He firmly believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and his menus are carefully crafted to provide both sustenance and enjoyment.

Alistair's meticulous planning and calm demeanor make him a valuable asset to any team. He excels at managing budgets, sourcing local ingredients, and adapting to the unique challenges of a mobile catering operation. His dedication to quality and his ability to create a welcoming atmosphere have earned him the respect of drivers, mechanics, and team personnel alike. What sets Alistair apart is his uncanny ability to remember everyone's favorite dish and dietary requirements, ensuring that every member of the team feels catered for.

physical.description: Alistair is a stout man with a friendly, approachable face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas and dietary requests.
Insists on brewing his own blend of tea using a vintage kettle.
Unfailingly offers everyone a biscuit with their tea, even if they've just eaten.
